articles.title: Meld skincare dispenser allows users to mix their own preservative-free formulas
articles.summary: British designer Beth Morgan Lundie created a refillable skincare dispenser that lets users mix preservative‑free formulas at home. The system eliminates toxic additives by allowing ingredient customization. It debuted as her graduation project at Central Saint Martins.

articles.title: Montreal restaurant Minnibar by Ivy Studio "embraces its raw shell"
articles.summary: Ivy Studio designed Minnibar, a light‑filled Italian restaurant in Montreal that embraces Japanese minimalism. The space uses the building’s 20‑foot ceilings and features in‑house designed chairs. The design highlights raw shell aesthetics and a minimalist interior.

articles.title: 6 Sustainable Home Furnishings for Healthy Living
articles.summary: Design Milk showcases six eco‑conscious home furnishings, ranging from solar‑powered outdoor lighting to 3D‑printed items. Each product blends sustainability with contemporary style. The collection demonstrates that green design can remain chic.

articles.title: This Damascus Steel compact EDC knife packs two sliders into a 0.6-inch body
articles.summary: A Damascus steel compact EDC knife packs two sliders into a 0.6‑inch body, a rare feat for pocket tools. The design combines sleek aesthetics with functional versatility. It showcases advanced blade engineering in a miniature form.

articles.title: This Iron Frying Plate Sears Food on Bare Steel & Goes Straight From the Stove to Your Table
articles.summary: The Iron Frying Plate is a bare‑steel cookware that eliminates the transfer step by cooking and serving directly from the stove. Its design focuses on meal preparation efficiency and durability. The product blurs the line between cooking and plating.

articles.title: Replace 100 Tutorial Videos With This One Smart Keyboard
articles.summary: A smart keyboard replaces hundreds of tutorial videos by providing instant, context‑aware guidance for creative software. The device integrates AI to adapt to user skill levels and software updates. It aims to streamline learning for Photoshop, Illustrator, and more.

articles.title: A Chess Set So Well-Designed It Doubles as Desk Art
articles.summary: A newly designed chess set doubles as desk art, merging classic gameplay with contemporary aesthetics. The set features minimalist pieces that also serve as decorative elements. It offers a fresh take on a traditional board game.

articles.title: Smart Glasses Run Hot. A 1mm Fan Might Finally Fix That.
articles.summary: Smart glasses often overheat, and a 1‑mm fan could mitigate the issue. The proposed fan integrates into the glasses frame to cool the lenses and electronics. The solution addresses a practical design flaw in wearable tech.

articles.title: Artefilo Makes Home Objects From Elephant Grass and Hospital Cabinets
articles.summary: Artefilo transforms elephant grass and repurposed hospital cabinets into home objects, promoting circular design. The collection showcases how discarded materials can become stylish, functional items. It challenges the credibility gap in eco‑conscious marketing.

articles.title: A Natural History Museum That Actually Looks Like Nature
articles.summary: A new natural history museum is designed to resemble the natural environment it houses. The building’s architecture mimics organic forms, creating an immersive experience. It redefines the traditional museum aesthetic.

articles.title: The Fridge Screen Your Family Can Update From Anywhere Without Texting
articles.summary: The Fridge Screen is a digital notice board that can be updated remotely without texting. It replaces paper notes with a touch‑screen interface on the refrigerator. The design improves household communication and organization.

articles.title: The 7 Best Desk Gadgets & Tools of July 2026 for College Students
articles.summary: A roundup of the best desk gadgets for college students highlights tools that boost productivity and comfort. The list includes ergonomic accessories, smart organizers, and tech gadgets. It serves as a guide for dorm‑room setups.

articles.title: EA House / Bokey Grant
articles.summary: EA House is a family home built onto a cliff face in the southern highlands, using a simple elemental gesture to respond to the site. The design addresses environmental constraints while creating an intimate living space. It exemplifies experimental architecture on a challenging terrain.

articles.title: Cafe N+ / Horibe Associates
articles.summary: Cafe N+ connects a historic shrine with a new performing arts theater, creating a vibrant hub in Takatsuki City. The design harmonizes with the landscape while maintaining a distinct identity. It serves as a cultural bridge between tradition and modernity.

articles.title: Looking South House / PLUG arquitectura modular
articles.summary: Looking South House is a modular house in Chapadmalal, blending rural and coastal influences. The design uses modular construction to adapt to the local climate and culture. It showcases how architecture can respond to regional context.

articles.title: Riera Renovation / LABLANCA
articles.summary: Riera Renovation updates a flat in a 1960s building, creating a courtyard‑based layout within a narrow plot. The design reconfigures space to maximize light and openness. It demonstrates adaptive reuse of historic interiors.

articles.title: What a children’s toy can teach us about considered design - DesignWanted
articles.summary: A children's toy offers lessons in considered design, emphasizing safety, usability, and play value. The article explores how toy design can inform broader product development. It highlights the importance of thoughtful design from an early age.

articles.title: BGF Retail Wins Red Dot Design Award - Seoul Economic Daily
articles.summary: BGF Retail has been awarded the prestigious Red Dot Design Award for its retail solutions. The recognition highlights the company's commitment to innovative design and customer experience. The award underscores BGF Retail’s leadership in the retail sector.

articles.title: designboom shop drop: limited release of watches and architectural jewelry
articles.summary: designboom’s shop drop releases limited‑time watches and architectural jewelry, blending timekeeping with sculptural form. The collection showcases curated pieces that merge design and jewelry. It offers collectors a unique, limited‑edition experience.

articles.title: san francisco’s exploratorium turns STEM learning into hands‑on play
articles.summary: San Francisco’s Exploratorium transforms STEM learning into interactive play through exhibits like geysers and DNA displays. The museum encourages hands‑on experimentation for all ages. It redefines educational engagement in a playful environment.

articles.title: ippolito pestellini laparelli and erica petrillo of 2050+ on ‘the parking lot that forgot itself’
articles.summary: 2050+ discusses how informal sport and architecture can challenge surveillance and reclaim public space. The essay examines public space as an urban commons. It explores how design can strengthen community engagement.

articles.title: To the Red Dot Newsroom
articles.summary: The Red Dot Design Award’s newsroom provides updates on award winners and industry news. It serves as a communication hub for designers and media. The page offers insights into the award’s activities.

articles.title: General press information on the Red Dot Design Award
articles.summary: This page offers general press information about the Red Dot Design Award, including media contacts and guidelines. It serves as a resource for journalists covering the award. The content provides background on the award’s history and criteria.
